funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Author Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals at any stage in their career with a confirmed publisher and a scheduled publication date within three years of applying.
opportunities.summary: Provides financial support for authors to publish monographs, edited collections, catalogues and articles that reflect advanced research in British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Individual Research Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals at any career stage; tiered funding up to £3,000, £3,001‑£8,000, or £8,001‑£20,000 for post‑doctoral level researchers.
opportunities.summary: Flexible financial support for research travel and/or research time to address specific research questions in British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Study Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Students enrolled in or about to start a master's or doctoral degree in British art, visual culture or architecture.
opportunities.summary: Provides a fixed £5,000 award to support students beginning or continuing postgraduate study in the field.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Andrew Wyld Research Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered students (undergraduate level and above) from any country researching eighteenth‑ or nineteenth‑century British works on paper.
opportunities.summary: Supports research trips to examine historical works on paper (prints, drawings, watercolours) in person.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Master's Degree Scholarship
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals with an offer for a UK master’s degree (MA, MPhil, MSc or equivalent) starting between April 2027 and April 2028.
opportunities.summary: Full funding (up to £32,000) for a one‑year master’s programme (or split over two years part‑time).

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Doctoral Scholarship
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals with an offer for a UK doctoral programme starting between April 2027 and April 2028 (including international students).
opportunities.summary: Full funding for doctoral study, covering tuition and living costs (£32,000 per year for three years).

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Early Career Fellowship
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Post‑doctoral level researchers (or equivalent experience) or above.
opportunities.summary: Provides £35,000 per year (up to two years) to undertake a major research project that reshapes understanding of British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Rome Fellowship
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Scholars, researchers, curators, archivists and GLAM professionals (pre‑doctoral to internationally recognised) with at least a first degree.
opportunities.summary: Three‑month residency at the British School at Rome, providing board, accommodation and an honorarium for research on a British‑Italian topic.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Research Project Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any organisation, institution or nonprofit (collaborative applications welcome).
opportunities.summary: Flexible support for organisations undertaking ambitious and sustained research projects in British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Exhibition Publication Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any organisation, institution or non‑profit; exhibition may be forthcoming or already held.
opportunities.summary: Supports the production of publications associated with exhibitions that showcase new research in British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Event Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any organisation, institution or nonprofit; collaborative applications welcome.
opportunities.summary: Provides funding to support live, online or hybrid events that disseminate research on British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Conservation Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any organisation, institution or nonprofit undertaking conservation research on items in public or charitable ownership.
opportunities.summary: Supports vital conservation research on items from an organisation's own collections.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Digitisation Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any organisation, institution or nonprofit undertaking digitisation of its own collections.
opportunities.summary: Provides funding to make collections freely available online through digitisation projects.
